as_told.title: University parapsychology programs and the constricted present

plain: Several elite US universities once ran research programmes in parapsychology, the study of claimed psychic abilities, among them the Rhine Center connected with Duke, a lab at Princeton, and SRI, a research institute tied to Stanford. Michels says this himself, and on another episode adds that these programmes came out saying "it seems like there's a constricted present," the idea that the present moment is narrower than it seems. He brings it up to show that serious institutions took the subject seriously.
